summary: Iteration 54 — Marketplace de Banners (Section 57). 20/20 backend pytest cases pass: publish auth-gating (provider only, 403 for client), public listing (sort=popular pinned-first, sort=recent timestamp-desc, style filter, limit capped @60, offset pagination), /banners/me, DELETE (owner+admin allowed, others 403, cascades likes), like toggle (400 self-like, 404 missing, count increments/decrements, idempotent via unique index), like-state for current user, fire-and-forget view counter, and the 5-banner cap rotation (auto-deletes oldest non-pinned on 6th publish). Frontend: /galeria-banners renders banner-gallery-page, all 6 filter pills (all/modern/festive/professional/minimal/warm) + sort buttons (popular/recent) present; grid populates with seeded banners; festive filter narrows correctly to festive-only; modal opens via gallery-card-open-{id} and closes via gallery-modal-close; demo.client like toggle works (12→13→12, button turns rose-colored); demo.provider self-like correctly disabled with title='You can\'t like your own banner' and cursor-not-allowed; empty state [data-testid=gallery-empty] renders when filter returns 0 results; header [data-testid=nav-banner-gallery] href correctly routes to /banner-gallery (EN) or /galeria-banners (ES).

issues: Hero/UI language is driven entirely by the React lang context (localStorage 'lang'), NOT by the URL. Both /galeria-banners and /banner-gallery render the same content. The user's spec says 'ES default routes use /galeria-banners' which suggests the route SHOULD pin the language, but the page currently shows whatever lang the user last picked. Consider syncing route → lang on mount (if path === '/galeria-banners' set lang=es, else set lang=en) so deep-links from social/SEO land in the expected locale.

Lightbox modal: when grid is small (e.g. 1 card under festive filter), the modal renders correctly but the underlying scrolled page is visible behind the dimmer at lower opacity; backdrop is OK but adding overflow-hidden on <body> while open would be a polish nicety.
Seeded demo banner image_urls are 1×1 transparent PNGs — confirmed expected by main agent. Cards look empty but layout/structure validates correctly. Real banners will fill these.

action_items: (low) Consider URL-driven language pin for /galeria-banners vs /banner-gallery routes so cross-locale deep-links display the correct hero/labels regardless of cached lang.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now exceeds 9849 lines — the Banner Marketplace section adds ~155 lines on top of the existing growth. Strongly recommend extracting Sections 49 (banner generate) + 57 (banner marketplace) into a banners_router.py module; the file is becoming hard to navigate.

publish_banner: the auto-rotation logic does count_documents then find_one then delete_one then delete_many — 4 sequential round-trips on every publish at-cap. Could be collapsed using find_one_and_delete with sort=created_at,1 + a single delete_many on banner_likes.

publish_banner returns the full document with hard-coded fields (likes=0, views=0, pinned=False) — fine, but emitting `_id` exclusion in the projection `{k: v for k, v in doc.items() if k != '_id'}` is defensive against a future change. Safe but worth a comment that insert_one mutates `doc` to add `_id`.

toggle_banner_like: after delete-then-update_one $inc, if the user has stale concurrent requests the counter can drift below 0 in pathological cases. Adding a {likes: {$gt: 0}} filter on the $inc -1 path would harden it.

Like-state endpoint is gated by get_current_user — anonymous users get 401 (verified in test_like_state_anon_unauthorized). Front-end correctly handles this by only fetching like-state when authenticated; just confirming behavior is intentional.
Public listing endpoint does not project away the heavy `keywords` field — fine at current scale but if keywords gets large for SEO this is wasted bandwidth.
No rate-limit on POST /banners/{share_id}/view — could be hammered to inflate view counts. Consider IP+share TTL dedup like the existing track-share-view endpoint.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on testable flows (9/9 critical UI flows: page-load, filter pills present, sort buttons present, grid populated, festive-filter narrows, modal opens+closes, client like toggle on/off + rose color, provider self-like disabled with correct title+cursor, empty state appears when filter returns 0, header nav-banner-gallery href correct)

seed_data_creation: Test pollution: the cap-rotation test publishes a 6th banner (style=warm) → backend correctly auto-deletes oldest non-pinned (the original 'Modern' demo banner) → test then asserts the new banner exists → teardown deletes the new banner via admin. NET effect on demo data: the original Modern demo banner is now gone. 4 demo banners remain (Festive pinned + Professional + Minimalist + Warm). This actually let us validate the empty state on the Modern filter. Demo client now has 3 likes left on the gallery (1 from prior iteration + 2 added post-test for screenshot realism: festive=13, professional=10, plus the pre-existing modern was removed by rotation). Re-seeding the Modern banner is optional — the gallery still demonstrates all 4 visible styles.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Banner Marketplace endpoints + UI fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_iter54_banner_marketplace.py (20 cases) and the Playwright runs documented in this iteration. The banner-publish-btn testid in BannerGenerator.jsx is conditionally rendered when composedUrl state has a value — it was NOT visible in DOM during the Playwright run because we did not actually call /api/providers/me/generate-banner (costs OpenAI credits, explicitly out-of-scope per main agent instructions). The testid IS present in /app/frontend/src/components/BannerGenerator.jsx line 440 (verified via grep). Demo banners post-iteration54: 4 visible (Festive pinned 13 likes, Professional 10 likes, Minimalist 6 likes, Warm 3 likes). If next iteration needs the Modern style back, run a one-off insert against banner_shares. Lang toggle button in header didn't switch on click via Playwright (selector matched but UI did not flip) — likely needs the proper LangSwitcher dropdown path; not a blocker for this iteration since UI text matches whichever lang context returns.
rca of the issue: No bugs blocking acceptance. Only a soft design observation: URL-vs-lang-context decoupling means /galeria-banners can render EN copy if the cached lang is EN. Main agent may choose to leave this as-is (current Header.jsx already updates the nav link href based on lang context, so navigations between locales stay coherent) or sync route→lang on mount of BannerGalleryPage.
